name: Richard Wagner
summary: Detail-oriented and proactive Security Engineer with over 5 years of experience in developing and implementing secure systems and applications. Adept at conducting security audits and implementing best practices to safeguard company assets. Passionate about staying ahead of emerging threats and technology.

description: Develop security policies and procedures to mitigate risks and enhance overall security posture.
Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to identify and remediate potential threats.
Implement and maintain security tools and technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM solutions.
Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated into the software development lifecycle.
Lead incident response efforts and provide expert guidance on resolving security breaches.
Assisted in the development of security policies and procedures.
Monitored network traffic for suspicious activity and investigated security incidents.
Provided support to the security team in analyzing vulnerabilities and implementing remediation measures.
Helped in the creation of security training and awareness programs for employees.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Developed a secure web application that complies with OWASP Top Ten guidelines.
Conducted a company-wide security awareness campaign which resulted in a 30% reduction in phishing incidents.
